regression: The first three new cases fail against c41807c: a different selected workspace is silently adopted, the previous layout survives a failed destination snapshot, and a failed pre-switch save replaces unsaved edits. Two further cases cover a lost selection acknowledgement and an unread destination followed by another selection.
behavior: A reconnect cannot move an existing draft into a workspace selected by another window; the workspace menu makes that change deliberate.
The previous layout is saved before selection, then retired with its workflow, policy, profile choices and integration context before the destination is read.
A failed pre-switch save preserves the unsaved layout and does not select another workspace.
An acknowledged switch with a failed snapshot exposes retry and prevents saving old content into the destination. An unread destination retains its identity.
Lost acknowledgements are read back without repeating selection during connection retry.
